responsibility: This definition module declares a generic dynamic index structure that maps CARDINAL indices to ADDRESS values. It belongs to the gm2 runtime utility layer and exports constructors, bounds queries, indexed get/put operations, inclusion/removal helpers, deletion, iteration callbacks, and an optional debug mode, providing a reusable sparse-like expandable array abstraction used by modules such as FIO.
same_name_distinction: This is the public interface for the generic index container, declaring the abstract Index type and operations without exposing the resizable backing array, occupancy tracking, or memory-motion details implemented in Indexing.mod.
